units.source_text: 二女公子见他如此坚决要求，说道：

en.t: Seeing how firmly he pressed his request, the Second Princess said:

units.source_text: “这便怎么好呢！

en.t: How can this be right?

units.source_text: 父亲不承认她为女儿，我却随口泄漏出去，实在太多嘴了。

en.t: Father does not acknowledge her as his daughter, yet I let it slip so carelessly; I have truly said far too much.

units.source_text: 但我听见你说，要找神工鬼斧来替姐姐雕像，我心十分感动，因此说出这个人来。”

en.t: But when I heard you say that you wished to find a master craftsman to carve a statue for my elder sister, I was deeply moved, and so I mentioned this person.

units.source_text: 便告诉他：“此人多年来住在很远的乡间。

en.t: Then she told him, This person has lived for many years in a distant country place.

units.source_text: 她的母亲可怜她，定要她和我通信交往。

en.t: Her mother pitied her and insisted that she correspond and keep company with me.

units.source_text: 我未便置之不理，便时时给她回信。

en.t: I could not very well ignore her, so from time to time I sent her replies.

units.source_text: 前些时她就来访我了。

en.t: Some time ago she came to visit me.

units.source_text: 也许是灯光之下看不清吧，但见其人浑身上下无论哪一点，都比我所预想的漂亮得多。

en.t: Perhaps I could not see clearly by lamplight, but every part of her, from head to foot, seemed far more beautiful than I had expected.

units.source_text: 她的母亲正在担心她的前程。

en.t: Her mother is anxious about her future.

units.source_text: 倘能蒙你供奉她为宇治山乡的本尊佛菩萨，真是她的无上幸福了。

en.t: If she could receive your favor and be enshrined by you like the principal Buddha of the mountain village of Uji, it would be the greatest happiness for her.

units.source_text: 但恐这是盼不到的吧。”

en.t: But I fear that is more than she can hope for.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言猜想：二女公子表面上虽然说得头头是道，其实是讨厌他的啰唣，想设法打发他。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, guessed that although the Second Princess spoke with perfect reason on the surface, in truth she was weary of his persistence and was trying to find a way to send him off.

units.source_text: 因此他心中颇感不快。

en.t: Because of this, he felt quite displeased in his heart.

units.source_text: 然而想起那个肖似大女公子的人，毕竟有些眷恋。

en.t: Yet when he thought of the person who so closely resembled the Elder Princess, he could not help feeling some attachment.

units.source_text: 他想：“她虽然深恶痛绝我那不应有的恋情，但表面上不做出使我难堪的行为来，可见她颇能体谅我的心意。”

en.t: He thought, Although she deeply detests this improper love of mine, she does not openly do anything to embarrass me; that shows she understands my feelings rather well.

units.source_text: 便觉心情异常兴奋。

en.t: At that thought, his feelings became extraordinarily stirred.

units.source_text: 此时夜已很深。

en.t: By this time the night was already very deep.

units.source_text: 帘内的二女公子深恐侍女们看了不成体统，便趁薰中纳言不防之时悄悄地退入内室。

en.t: Behind the curtain, the Second Princess was deeply afraid that it would look improper if the waiting women saw them, so while Kaoru was off his guard she quietly withdrew into the inner room.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言左右寻思，觉得二女公子的退避是应该的。

en.t: Kaoru considered the matter from every side and felt that the Second Princess had been right to withdraw.

units.source_text: 然而心中还是不胜怨恨惋惜，情思无法镇静。

en.t: Yet in his heart he still could not bear his resentment and regret, and his emotions would not settle.

units.source_text: 眼泪即将夺眶而出，又恐被人讥笑，只得努力忍住。

en.t: Tears were about to burst from his eyes, but fearing that others would laugh at him, he had no choice but to hold them back with all his strength.

units.source_text: 百感交集，方寸恼乱。

en.t: A hundred feelings crowded together, and his heart was in turmoil.

units.source_text: 但他明白：不顾一切地胡行乱为，为人为己两皆不利，毕竟是使不得的。

en.t: But he understood that to act recklessly without regard for anything would harm both her and himself, and in the end it was something he must not do.

units.source_text: 于是竭力忍耐，起身告辞而出，愁叹之声比往日更苦。

en.t: So he endured with all his strength, rose to take his leave, and went out, his sighs of sorrow more painful than ever before.
